title: Beneath the Surface
voice_brief: Sophisticated, grounded, mature narrator. Restrained British or neutral international English. Measured authority, understated warmth, precise articulation. Never an announcer; never whispering; no forced drop at sentence ends.

AegisStore.note: EE-jis store, two words, equal weight

CloudFire.note: two clear syllables, stress on CLOUD

lines.text: Just after someone presses a button, a product keeps its promise, [pause 0.3] or quietly breaks it.
lines.direction: As if noticing something for the first time and sharing it with one person. Unhurried. A small breath before 'or quietly breaks it', which lands softly, almost privately, not ominously.

lines.text: What decides it is rarely on the screen.
lines.direction: A gentle reveal. Slight lift on 'rarely'. Let 'screen' resolve without dropping away.

lines.text: We build both sides of that moment.
lines.direction: Settled, matter-of-fact confidence. Warmth on 'both sides'. No sales emphasis.

lines.text: Automation carries the busywork, and a person still approves what matters.
lines.direction: Light and clear on the first clause; the second clause is the point. Slight weight on 'a person'.

lines.text: Releases go out on an ordinary afternoon, and nobody holds their breath.
lines.direction: A hint of a smile on 'ordinary afternoon' and 'nobody holds their breath'. Understatement, not a joke.

lines.text: When a storage node goes dark in AegisStore, [pause 0.2] the files keep coming back, verified.
lines.direction: Proud but factual, like showing a colleague something that works. A beat before 'verified', which is said with quiet certainty.

lines.text: Good engineering rarely asks to be noticed. [pause 0.45] It simply holds.
lines.direction: Slower. Reflective. 'It simply holds' is the thesis of the film: grounded, warm, final without being dramatic.
Said simply, as a signature. Not announced. Falling but warm.

alternates.text: The hardest journey is redesigned until it feels obvious.
alternates.direction: Clean and even. A small, satisfied resolution on 'obvious'.
alternates.reason: Cut after timing the selected voice: Act III ran at 82% speech density. The Experience & Growth visual (tangled journey resolving to one screen) carries the idea without words and gives the score room to build into Act IV.
